body:
[A10] The builder accepted AUDIO_UNIT rate lists that the PP (protocol processor) cannot walk: a ninth advertised rate could be rejected by SET_SAMPLING_RATE. This change refuses lists longer than eight and duplicate entries, and detects drift between the hand-built pp_shadow rate list and its shipping configuration.

## Status

Implementation frozen at 1496558d82cf35fc98dda0e781b2a1be643c301a, tree e8d797554a935c5514e25be9e1dda119f4f8c999, against dev 88e9276b2a220c716f64a843f7e1eb8f9265e896. The complete corrected-head local bar is posted in the validation comment. This head includes the pinned PP documentation link correction requested by R221/R222 and integrates the current dev base. Trusted act, hosted checks and corrected-head independent reviews remain separate requirements.

Closes #478
Relates to #509
PP contract: https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/89

Executor A156 (Codex), link correction A169 (Codex); independent cleared-context reviewers R221 (internal Codex) and R222 (external Opus); manager A10.

## Description

A named maximum beside BASE_RATE_HZ mirrors PP memory-map rule L10. `_load_clocking` raises cause-specific ConfigError for a distinct ninth entry or any duplicate after integer conversion. Order, current-rate membership and omitted-list defaults are preserved.

Builder gate 36a exercises a legal eight-entry loader boundary, independent count and duplicate refusals, all five shipping images, and the existing literal pp_shadow AU_RATES_C values and declared length. Separate value, order, length, initializer and commented-declaration controls must fail. The pp_shadow image remains hand-built. The authoritative builder schema documents the bound.

The original builder implementation is preserved. The later correction changes one documentation link to the pinned PP commit, allowing documentation validation before submodule initialization. The complete corrected issue delta is unchanged across the current-dev integration. All five shipping config files and packed descriptor images are unchanged in the author's measured before/after comparison. No PP pin, donor implementation, runtime-rate policy or shipping-rate list is changed.

Authority: REQUIREMENTS.md REQ-VER-03/04; pinned PP `docs/architecture/07_memory_maps.md` section 3.1 L10; Milan v1.2 section 5.3.3.3; #478's public readiness decision and assignment.

## How to reproduce

Fetch branch `478-audio-unit-rate-bound`, check out 1496558d82cf35fc98dda0e781b2a1be643c301a, and initialize `third_party/verilog-axis`, `protocol-processor` and `gptp-processor` at their gitlinks. The unused external submodule is not a validation dependency.

## How to validate

Run `python3 sw/builder/test_builder.py`, `python3 scripts/lint_rtl.py --check`, `python3 scripts/xvlog_gate.py --check`, the documentation gates and the complete CONTRIBUTING native bar: parent suite sweep, Yosys, both processor suites and behave. Gate 36a must reject each independent defect and accept its legal controls. Complete commands, exact heads, logs and disclosed skips are in the manager evidence comments.

Historical author and first-round manager evidence (original head identities retained): https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/b671cc625534af2d50f91f1fd0f8dac1ab49c991/review-evidence/478-r1 . Current corrected-head full evidence is linked in the validation comment. The first-round negative reviews remain open until their authors re-review this head. Evidence branch never merges. The calibrated resource-report arm (builder gate 11) and field-campaign skips do not supply hardware evidence.

## Definition of Done

- [x] Issue scope, decision and roles public; coherent implementation and focused author evidence.
- [x] Input contract documented; shipping rates preserved.
- [ ] Required complete native and exact-head hosted checks pass; trusted act replica passes.
- [ ] Two independent positive reviews; all five reviewer-owned lenses clean; no review in flight.
- [ ] Current-dev merge candidate validated; actual merge tree and post-merge containment verified.
- [ ] Issue closed and Project Done after all completion checks.
title: fix(builder): bound AUDIO_UNIT sampling rates to the PP contract
